text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

"Their running abilities were practically dead even.
All three of them are Umamusume who represent their respective generations."
Then, the decisive factor is—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Kita-san!! Right there, Kita-san!!

text_block_list.name: Groove & Brusque
text_block_list.text: Kitasan...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan, goooooo!!
Please win this, Kitasaaaan!!
(UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black! It's Kitasan Black!
Crossing the finish line first is—
Kitasan Black!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Stealing the spotlight and taking the grand finale on the year-end's most brilliant stage!
Way to go, our star of the common folk!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Did I do it...? I did it...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, YESSSSS!!!!!!
Finally... in our very first serious match, I beat Dia-chan...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's not all...
Even to Teio-san, whom I look up to...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaay!!!!!!!!!!
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan... I lost...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, Kita-chan's Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I thought... I had gotten closer.
That's what I thought...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Still... this... final gap was...
choice_data_list: ...Maybe it's just the difference in the number of wishes.
...Maybe it's just the difference in the number of wishes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The number of wishes...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it...
While I was running, I could hear it.
That incredible cheering for Kita-chan...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Those folks especially, who were shouting at the top of their lungs...
choice_data_list: These are the fans who have cheered you on all this time.
These are the fans who have cheered you on all this time.

text_block_list.text:
Every Umamusume grows stronger running alongside her rivals.
However, Kitasan Black...

Not just with my rivals, but together with the fans
who fell in love with my racing, I've kept running...
always...

Even the faint warmth of individual people, once gathered together like this,
becomes a roaring, fiery cheer. And then—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Thank you... so much...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much.
Thanks to you... thanks to you, I...!
choice_data_list: Take a look at the stands.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The stands... Ah...
And right there—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Kitasan Black!
Thank you, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That was a freaking amazing race!!!!
It was the best... absolute best, damn it!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a-aaah... Everyone is...
Everyone is smiling so much...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Finally, I'm finally...!

The number of wishes. And,
"What lies beyond victory that you strive for?"

It was an overwhelming victory for Kitasan Black,
who single-mindedly ran for the sake of everyone's smiles.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan, as expected of a Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Teio-san...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"It's been so long since I felt this frustrated.
And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly thrilled that an Umamusume has appeared
who can make me feel this frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Especially since it's you, who's been chasing
after me all this time. I think I understand
how the Prez felt a little better now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No way...! The pleasure is all mine!
I'm so thrilled to be able to run alongside you like this, Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. In order to stay someone you look up to,
I have to get even stronger myself.
...Well, see you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, Dia-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Pinky promise... Will you do it with me again?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want you to run with me again, no matter what.
Because I still want to keep chasing after you, Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I want to do more and more
with you too, Dia-chan!

—Forging an eternal promise.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so much for coming
today!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Did everyone have a good time!?
(UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Even though it took quite a while...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was finally able to run a race
that brought smiles to everyone's faces.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: This is what a festival is all about! This is what I've always wanted to do! But—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Because I gave it my all, I can see what comes next.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This isn't the end! If we put our minds to it,
we could throw an even bigger, more amazing festival!
But that's...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I can't do it alone. I need way, way
more cheers, and way, way more friends beside me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's why starting today, I'll be
not just the 'Helper General,'
but the 'Festival General' too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll keep chasing after my seniors, keep guiding my juniors, and bring everyone together as one...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
An even more incredible stage. For that to happen,
I need to get so much stronger myself!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Big enough to hoist this festival float
called the Twinkle Series right from the center!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Will you come with me?!
(Oooooooooooo!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Are you all ready to get hyped up together with me,
the "Festival General"?!
(Oooooooooooo!)
Her provocations were vivid and brilliant. In this race, Kitasan Black may have finally awakened to her true self.

—A general for everyone. Someone who can lead
even the most battle-hardened Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And next up is the singing segment!
Of course, just like with racing,
I'm going all out with my singing too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Together with my beloved friends
――putting my whole soul into it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Winning Live, here we gooooo!!!!!
Let's have the absolute best time, everyone!!!!!
(UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)
(BOOOM!!)

"It was... an earth-shattering roar of applause.
Voices celebrating 'Our Festival,'
which had continued since ancient times."

And so, Kitasan Black stood at the center of countless smiles—
becoming everyone's beloved horse girl.
